name: All A part of the Plan

system.description: As a Bonus action, you can spend 1 Superiority Die to roll 1d20, and recording the result. You can record up to 3 d20 rolls in this way at a time. These results last for 1 minute. When you would make a saving throw, you can substitute your result with any of your recorded results.

source.custom: Imported full source rules; contextual benefits require adjudication.
